Jeysie:
TakeWalker wrote:
No, I think this is happening after Oblivaeon, isn't it? Not gonna feel that safe beforehand!  
It happened after Plavu'Col was established, which I think was probably a few years before Progeny showed up, the time frame is a little vague.

Plavu’Col was founded around the return of Tempest and the relaunch of the Prime Wardens book, which hit issue #60 (5 years of monthly publication) for the death of Ra near the beginning of the OblivAeon event proper. The issue in the RPG Starter Kit is #67. Comic book time is weird, but that’s what we can look at for publishing timeline.

Edit for more: the ARG lists PW #36 as the earliest issue for the Progeny encounter (on the “Genocidal” page) and issues #49-54 are the XPW arc.
